Name: Swimming Pool - Farm Building (CP)
Author: yuninocorn
Description:
[b][size=4]General[/size][/b]
The swimming pool is a farm building designed for quick and easy access to renewing energy without having to travel to the bathhouse or another external location. The building is available for construction at the carpenter shop for 15,000g and 500 stones. It's 7 tiles wide and 5 tiles high.

I'm planning to add more visual options for this building in the future. If you have any suggestions, please leave them in the posts tab :)

Thanks to mushymato for converting the mod to run on Content Patcher!
https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/mushymato

[b][size=4]Usage[/size][/b]
To enter the pool, you simply walk in through the opening at the top right corner. Your character will change into their swimsuit behind the plant on the way in and out of it behind the frog on the way out. You're free to move around in the pool or stay still to replenish energy.
[b]
[/b][b][size=4]Installing (PC) [/size][/b]
To install this content pack, download the mod file and extract the .zip file to the 'Mods' folder in your Stardew Valley game folder. 

Enjoy!
